reviews.text:
ABSOLUTELY AVOID!! If you don't want to waste money, stay away!!!! In the space of 2 weeks, we paid €150 for 2 VISITATIONS in which they did NOTHING except confirm the problem we'd told them about our 4-year-old dog. Furthermore, WE ASKED them TWICE to write us a prescription for the medications I knew the dog needed. They give them those every time he gets dermatitis, but OBVIOUSLY, to make us SPEND MORE MONEY, they said they didn't need them and to come back next week to see how things went with their useless product given at every visit.
Oh, they welcome you into the room in 2/3 to give you a good impression of quality, but in reality, it's to extort more money from you.
In the end, I had to wait for the vet near my house to return from vacation to get the prescription for only, and I repeat, only, €15.
Thank you!

I absolutely do not recommend this clinic. A few months ago I went there with my guinea pig who was just under a year old and weighed half a kilo, which was quite thin. I told them his symptoms and the only thing they could tell me was that he needed vitamins. Within a week of the visit, he died. What kind of professional sees a guinea pig that weighs just under half a kilo and says it is due to a lack of vitamins? Even though I told him he didn't want to eat, that he was complaining as if something was wrong with him... Nevertheless, he only prescribed me a vitamin and scheduled an appointment for the next visit, which my guinea pig couldn't make... They only care about money...
Then they made me go around in circles with my budgie during the first visit I was present for, because when I spoke to them privately, they accused me of not being present, when in reality I was there. However, the only thing they told me was that the mucus wasn't serious. The doctor wasn't kind at all...
Then I went back for another visit, where I was greeted poorly and still told that the mucus wasn't anything serious. And at the third visit, only then were three tests worth €200 mentioned, of which two were done... And since I was never contacted for the third, and after contacting the vet to ask for explanations, the only thing I learned was that they had been I was charged for 2 tests when the doctor that day told me it was the total of 3. And I paid 200 for all 3!! I trusted these people blindly.
Because that's what was explained to me, and now it turns out it's not.
And I asked the doctor which of the 3 was the most important, and he said, "They're all three important, otherwise we can keep giving him antibiotics and going around in circles." Feeling pressured to pay for the "3," which in the end turned out to be 2...
What a lack of transparency and kindness to his customers...
Please, if you have the opportunity, avoid having a bad time at this place.
Thanks! Your little snakes are delicious!

Professional and friendly. The ability to chat quickly via WhatsApp is very convenient, and their reminder system, sent the day before your appointment, is extremely practical! They email you your test results. The facility is clean and well-equipped. The parrot assistant is definitely an added bonus! I met them during a very sad time when my cat had a bad diagnosis, and they were very empathetic but also practical in guiding us through the most painful decisions. Now, with my dog ​​and my other cat, we are getting along really well, between visits and simple vaccinations.

I don't recommend this clinic. I've never seen such superficiality in treating our little friends. They only ask for money without any treatment or without having solved the problem. Just two days later, they charged me for two visits, a total of €90. I think it's their technique: the first visit doesn't solve anything, so you come back again to charge you again and thus make more money. No other clinic has charged me twice or for each visit until they solved the problem. The first visit where I took my hamster, they didn't give me any medicine; they gave me the name of another one that had nothing to do with the problem I had brought my hamster for. 🐹 They didn't even give me a diagnosis. They simply concluded that it was heat stroke, but the hamster couldn't breathe well. I think it was due to an infection, given that his eyes were also stuck together. And he basically sent me home empty-handed with drops I'd paid more than €40 that didn't do anything. The next day, the hamster got worse; he was having spasms, feeling tired, and wasn't eating, and he was having difficulty breathing. I called in the morning and they told me they couldn't see him right away, but they'd come in the afternoon. However, the day I called for the first appointment, I couldn't go right away; they told me that if I waited, it would be worse for the money. At that moment, they could get him right away, but when I needed him right away, they strangely couldn't. So for the second appointment, I had him give me an anti-inflammatory, which was supposed to be covered by the first appointment fee, since they hadn't given me anything. Instead, they asked me for another €40, and the first appointment with nothing was €50, a total of €90 in two days. Then, that's not even including the useless drops I paid more than €40, and the eye drops I paid €12. I have photos of all the invoices and the condition my hamster was in. It was a truly terrible experience. I still don't know how the hamster will be over the next few days. Update: My hamster died this morning, Saturday, June 20, 2026, at around 7:30 a.m., after much suffering. According to the doctor, he was fine.
Kind and efficient
Kind, competent and very attentive.
Very good, attentive, helpful, and meticulous vets. Highly recommended!
Very professional, helpful, and kind, they successfully healed a cat with persistent problems. Congratulations to Dr. Fiorini and all her colleagues.

I took my dog ​​for prophylaxis before bringing her to the UK. They misprinted the date on the registration document, writing 2025 instead of 2026, and the same was true on the health certificate. At the border, they referred me to a vet to correct the error. I pointed this out, and the health director, upon learning of the incident, offered to reimburse the extra expenses incurred. It would be appropriate for her colleagues to take a cue from her in how they handle customer relationships.

They've been taking care of my turtle for over 15 years, and despite all her anemia problems, they've always treated her very well. They're all excellent. Dr. Rossi, then Dr. Fazio, Bonfanti, and recently I had to hospitalize her for a respiratory problem and anemia, and Dr. Fiorini took care of her. She's very kind, empathetic, listens to the owner, and cares about the animal. And this time, too, my turtle is doing much better. Thank you all. Fantastic.
Professionalism and competence

We brought our dog in for a urinary tract problem. An ultrasound scan was immediately suggested over the phone a week before, without a prior visit or any other check-up. The ultrasound and urine tests, which are very expensive, showed nothing. Over the next few days, we were repeatedly asked to see them again for blood tests, without being told why this would be necessary or that a specific medication might be prescribed to address the problem. We emailed them a prescription for the medication, and when we asked for the dosage and timing (always awaiting a response), they insisted on seeing the dog again, obviously for the blood tests.

While passing through Milan, we took our two cats for a checkup.
The staff was knowledgeable and friendly, and they immediately found the cause of one of the cats' ear problems.
We will definitely be back on our next trip to Milan for a checkup.

Highly recommended!
After two visits elsewhere, I came here to get a second opinion, and I have to say, it was top notch!
You saved my guinea pig Toby when I'd been told elsewhere he needed to be put down.
He's doing really well now!
Thank you so much

My experience with this clinic was very disappointing. I brought my dog ​​in urgently because he had a loose and bleeding nail. I was very anxious and expected more attention. The visit was limited to a quick disinfectant, a denial of my complaint about a missing nail, and no trimming of the fur around the wound or even an inspection of the other paw I'd reported (the visit cost €56).

The next day, I called back to let them know that the nail was indeed missing, and they told me, "It was there when I brought it in and it definitely fell off that same day." An unprofessional response, which gives the impression of minimizing the situation rather than taking it seriously.

Now the wound is not in good condition at all, and we are forced to take the dog urgently to our trusted veterinarian for proper treatment.

I don't recommend this clinic: you expect more attention, professionalism, and respect for those who trust you in delicate moments. :(
I brought my guinea pigs for a check-up, the doctor was very kind and available to clear up any doubts.
I am bringing my quite aggressive cat to them for regular vaccines etc. They are informing me well, speak English.

5/5 stars

I brought my bunny Luna due to a sudden illness, as our usual vet was away on vacation. Even though we arrived without an appointment, we were greeted with extreme kindness.

Dr. Rossi, assisted by a very professional nurse (since Luna is not easily taken care of), carefully examined her and provided us with all the necessary information. Dr. Rossi was always available via email, answering all my questions with great patience and professionalism.

A special thanks also to the nurse who greeted us with a warm smile and reassured us throughout the visit. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for competent and friendly veterinary service. Thank you so much, Dr. Rossi, for caring for my "little girl" with such dedication and kindness.
See you soon! 🐰❤️

I've known Dr. Bettio for years. He's meticulous, attentive, and highly knowledgeable, leaving nothing to chance. His calm and thoughtful nature instills confidence and reassures not only people, but especially animals. He's a very patient person, with a natural aptitude for four-legged creatures. My animals couldn't be in better hands.
Always kind and helpful. A true reference point for our four- and two-legged friends.

I brought my rabbit to this clinic about a month ago due to a stomach obstruction caused by an ingested foreign body. I have to sincerely thank the entire staff, especially Dr. Rossi and Dr. Paleari, for saving Brick. Thanks to their prompt intervention and post-operative care, he made a great recovery. Without their help, he certainly wouldn't have made it. I highly recommend this clinic for its expertise, compassion, and helpfulness. See you soon for his annual checkup.
Perfect
Doctor Rossi, a great professional
Very good with Sole he is healed
Very professional and helpful. The little kitten is doing very well with them.

very nice
and good
The staff is always friendly and efficient. I brought my guinea pig. They ran a test on her, and the results arrived by email the next morning.

We brought her rabbit. The first meeting with the doctor seemed nice. But only after the first meeting. A while ago, I had dental surgery (removal of front teeth). As soon as I woke up, everything was bloody, and she told me I had to take him home! I didn't sleep all night, I looked at him, I cried when I ate him, now I close my eyes, besides they are so expensive to charge money.
After a few months, we asked to keep the rabbit because Simona was going on vacation. When we picked him up, he was dirtier than when we brought him to the clinic, not brushed, and, as always, he charged a lot of money.
Last time, he needed surgery. When they gave me the estimate, I was scared. We decided to go outside of Milan, where we had been before, but it was a bit far. They did the surgery for three times less, I couldn't believe it. I don't want to go here anymore. I'm only interested in the money, though, too much, but that's my experience with them.

Dr. Paleari and the entire clinic staff have been caring for our two cats for three years now. Loving and dedicated, they detected a heart problem early, which was immediately managed. Communication was prompt and timely. Highly recommended!
I had a great time at this clinic, where my pets received the best care possible! The facility was clean, and the staff was very friendly and helpful!

Zero empathy, the cat was visibly suffering from ear infections and no treatment. They wanted to run a test to get the right antibiotic, but we had to wait at least 48 hours. I paid
50 euros to hear what I already knew. I had to request an anti-inflammatory and painkiller immediately afterward via email. I was lucky enough to accidentally meet my vet at the pharmacy, who had just returned from vacation and prescribed the right treatment.

First visit to this clinic for a checkup, microchip, and rabies vaccination for my feline. Everything was done perfectly and safely (for both the cat and them 😅). Very helpful, patient, and knowledgeable staff. Minimalist but clean environment. High prices. …

The experience with the clinic was excellent. The team is meticulous and attentive, but above all, clear in providing explanations and available for support when needed. We operated on a fairly senior rabbit, and the procedure was a …
The practice has a small waiting room with a ceiling fan, which is very useful these days. …
